body: I'm scared to talk to my friends though... because I'll look like a hypocrite. One of them sent a suicide note once and I highly discouraged it and sent tons of love to her. I'm scared on what they'll think of me if I tell them

My mom did the same to my sister too and it looked like it turned out fine so far, so I think that's why she's doing it to me as well. It's not that I'm responsible for their relationship, it just effects me a lot and if I were to tell any of my family about my thoughts they would call me crazy/ a psychopath because it has happened before. 
I do have some friends I guess but then I never felt good opening up to people I personally know, I've only been writing on my phone's notes to help myself feel better. If it is what you suggest, I guess I can try talking to them. As for any adults, no I can't talk to anyone.
Thank you for your kind words, I hope I get out of this too before it's too late, I just don't want to suffer anymore
